name: get_cluster
description: Get the details of an existing Google Cloud Managed Service for Apache Kafka cluster.

name.description: Required. The name of the cluster to retrieve. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster_id}

view.description: Optional. The view of the cluster to retrieve.
x-google-enum-descriptions: The default / unset value. The API will default to the BASIC view.
Include the basic metadata of the Cluster. This is the default value (for both ListClusters and GetCluster).
Include everything, including data fetched from the Kafka cluster source of truth.
